title: IRDAI Section 45
content: A life insurance policy cannot be questioned after three consecutive years from issuance except in cases of fraud.

title: ULIP Disclosure
content: ULIP illustrations must disclose both 4 percent and 8 percent gross return scenarios.

title: Smoker Classification
content: Any tobacco consumption within the previous 12 months is treated as smoker category.

title: HLV Rule
content: Applicants below age 35 may be eligible for up to 20 times annual income subject to underwriting guidelines.
